Ethan / team — looping in a short summary from legal so your procurement lawyers know what to expect in round 1. We will aim to keep negotiations to a minimum but want to be explicit on the items that typically change: 

Key DPA points (expect redline conversation):
- Data residency: select US or EU residency; if EU required, we will propose EU-hosted key materials and an addendum for data transfers.
- Breach notification: Redwood proposes 72-hour notification and cooperation; we typically accept contractual obligations to provide forensic deliverables under NDA.
- Liability and caps: standard mutual liability clause with carveouts for gross negligence; we can discuss a higher cap on data processing liabilities for regulated customers.
- Deletion/return: upon termination we offer a 90-day retrieval window; we can discuss longer retention/archival commitments for regulated records.
- Subprocessors/KMS: we list subprocessors in the appendix; for HSM/KMS custody we can offer bring-your-own-key options for Dedicated/Private deployments.

Action: please send any bank/legal team redlines to me directly (kimberly_park@redwood.com). We'll aim to return round 1 comments within 3 business days of receiving your redline set.

Kimberly Park

1) Retention: we require a guaranteed 5-year retention for AML transaction histories and associated audit logs. Is that achievable via Redwood archival exports or do we need a Dedicated deployment for that SLA? Please call out any cost/ops implications.

2) SIG/CAIQ and SOC2: we will accept SOC2 Type II under NDA. For SIG/CAIQ, we need a completed CAIQ PDF (not just the spreadsheet) mapped to evidence artifacts (control folder). Can Redwood provide a one-page control->evidence map for the subset of controls we flagged (Access Control, Logging, Change Management, Data Deletion)?

3) KMS: we need to understand KMS options. Customer-managed keys are preferred for production; can you confirm whether BYOK is available for the hosted offering or only for Dedicated/Private deployments?

4) Pen test and SSO: please confirm latest pen test summary and SSO (SAML/SCIM) readiness for our pilot users.

Finally — procurement would like to tentatively aim for DPA & contract signature by 2026-12-01 so that we can hit a staging window before year-end. If that changes on Redwood's side, let us know.

- Retention: 5-year archival is supported via our export + long-term object store workflow. For hosted customers we offer a managed archival add-on (additional cost). - Pen test & SSO: latest pen test summary v2026-06 is attached in the SOC2 summary; SAML+SCIM provisioning is available and Grace will coordinate a pilot SSO onboarding session after we have staging user list.
